summary.text: Timothy Corcoran is a Democratic state representative from Vermont who has represented the Bennington-2 District and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Timothy Corcoran II, gives his tenure in the Vermont House as beginning in 2003.

paragraphs.text: Timothy Corcoran was born in Bennington, Vermont.
He earned a B.A. from Johnson State College in 1996.
His career experience includes working in manufacturing and for Mahar McCarthy Real Estate.
In the Vermont House, Corcoran has served on the Transportation Committee and was its ranking member in 2019-2020 and 2021-2022.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
